description: All European roads (E-roads) and all roads connecting built-up areas, additionally, other roads can be included when it is needed to reach full connectivity of the transportation network (e.g. direct link between two built-up areas) or only way to reach a built-up area or isolated places (harbours, airports). Inside built-up areas only main roads (e.g. through roads) are portrayed. Roads are represented by one line regardless of the number of lanes or carriageways This dataset is provided by Tailte Éireann

links.title: ArcGIS FeatureServer Roads - 250k Map of Ireland (live Tailte Éireann service)

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry in WGS 84 (OGC:CRS84) after conversion; the service stores it in Irish Transverse Mercator (EPSG:2157). The only column declared as geometry.

table:columns.name: OBJECTID
table:columns.description: Internal row number of the ArcGIS service; not stable across data versions.

table:columns.name: FCsubtype
table:columns.description: Feature-class subtype code of the 250k product, distinguishing the classes of the feature (for example road or railway class).

table:columns.name: RTT
table:columns.description: Road traffic type code of the 250k product.

table:columns.name: LEN
table:columns.description: Length of the line as computed by the publisher, in metres.

table:columns.name: Shape__Length
table:columns.description: Perimeter or line length computed by the ArcGIS service in the units of its spatial reference (Irish Transverse Mercator metres); not derived from the converted WGS 84 geometry.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: STRUCT(xmin DOUBLE, ymin DOUBLE, xmax DOUBLE, ymax DOUBLE)
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the geometry as a struct of xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax, added by the GeoParquet conversion.
